mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, the weather is clear near the Military Ridge State Trail with temperatures feeling like 66 degrees. Expect a low of 55 degrees overnight with no rain expected.

In city news, the Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to guide future development, while Engineering Services continues providing regular reports to the Council regarding city infrastructure projects.

Today is packed with fun, including the Puppets in the Park festival at Century School Park, the Dane County Farmers Market, and live music at Bailey's Run. Looking ahead, you can catch yoga at Insight Wellness on October 12.
In a report from the police, on October 3, officers arrested a 19-year-old man in possession of a stolen firearm during a traffic stop for expired registration.
Enjoy the delicious Raspberry Cheesecake flavor of the day today! The store is currently open until 10:30 PM, so make sure to stop by soon.
